Git preflight (read-only).command: git rev-parse --show-toplevel && git rev-parse HEAD && git status --short

branchName.instructions: Use a new lowercase kebab-case branch (fix/,feat/,docs/,test/,audit/). Do not implement directly on main.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits type(scope): imperative summary; include verified tests only and never user data or secrets.

pullRequest.instructions: Summarize feature and scope, BASE_SHA and RESULT_SHA, PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN tests on exact SHA, Android 17 Pixel evidence, security/privacy, independent review, and explicit human approval required before merge.
